description: Validate an 18-digit Mexican CLABE bank account: SPEI bank code (with bank name), plaza, account and check digit. Offline; does not confirm the account exists. Price: 0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (pass the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']; failed calls are not charged). HTTP equivalent: POST https://json-canon-x402.fly.dev/v1/mx/clabe.

value.description: CLABE (18 digits). Spaces, dashes and lowercase are normalized.
